_comment: Read by scripts/check-requirements.ps1 (run automatically by build.cmd). min = lowest accepted version; wingetId = package installed with winget when the tool is missing and you agree.

tools.name: .NET SDK
tools.why: builds the terminal app (a runtime alone is not enough, the SDK is required)

tools.name: Node.js
tools.why: builds posh.exe; the produced posh.exe is a copy of this node.exe (22 LTS recommended)

npm.name: npm
npm.why: installs the posh build tools below (ships with Node.js; only needed when they are not installed yet)
